_doc: One present-state record per ingredient, fusing pricing posture + own-baseline band, edible/cooked yield + trim tax, cheapest month, the price hedge swap, present pipeline direction, and the US import stream. Every field is descriptive of the tracked record — never a delivered/retail price, never a forecast, and co-occurrence is never cause. us_import_value_usd is the latest full calendar year of US general import VALUE for the ingredient's HS6 (US Census, public domain), nominal (mixes volume and price) — never import volume (not published at HS6). import_peak_months are the three highest-import calendar months averaged over 2010-2025; import_peak_quarter_share is the peak quarter's share of a typical year's import value (a within-year ratio, inflation-immune) — both descriptive seasonality, the supply-timing tell of when an ingredient leans on imports. import_top_sources / import_source_hhi / import_source_concentration describe the 2025 source-country mix (real countries only, trade blocs and continents excluded) and its Herfindahl concentration — a descriptive supply-diversity fact (raspberry ~100% Mexico, lobster ~99% Canada), never a risk forecast. import_annual_usd carries the full 2010-2025 annual series; import_yoy_pct is the latest full year versus the prior year (a descriptive change, nominal). notable_events_n, median_shock_days and biggest_move_pct+date summarize the ingredient's own notable sustained price moves in the deep history (descriptive, from the events dataset — a departure from its own baseline, never a delivered price). comovers lists the ingredients that most often moved the same way in the same six-week window, as k of this ingredient's own n moves — co-occurrence, NEVER cause. us_export_value_usd is the latest full year of US DOMESTIC exports (US Census, DF=1 = US-produced goods excluding foreign re-exports, HS6, nominal value). us_production_usd + farm_price are USDA NASS national annual figures (public domain); farm_price is a FARM-GATE price — a distinct point in the chain, never the wholesale reference. import_reliance_pct is import value as a share of APPARENT CONSUMPTION (production + imports − exports), all year-aligned — a descriptive cross-point proxy (the figures sit at different points in the chain: import value carries freight the farm-gate price does not), never a supply-security score, and withheld where the source granularities cannot form a clean share. Fields are null where a layer does not cover an ingredient.

records.name: Pork loin
records.import_note: Frozen pork cuts (NESOI); HS10 has no loin-specific line, so pork-loin stays on this shared frozen-cuts stream. Belly and shoulder now have their own HS10 codes below.

records.name: Pork shoulder
records.import_note: Fresh bone-in pork shoulder, summed with the frozen ham+shoulder line (0203229000); boneless shoulder sits in the cuts NESOI bucket.

records.name: Red onion
records.import_note: HS6 combines onions and shallots; not split by color/variety.

records.name: Red potato

records.name: Ribeye
records.import_note: The boneless beef RIB primal (fresh), of which ribeye is the principal cut; summed with its frozen twin (0202305025). HS10 splits beef by primal, not retail cut; US statistical data from 2017.

records.name: Russet potato
records.import_note: Fresh table potatoes; not split by variety.

records.name: Striploin
records.import_note: The boneless beef LOIN primal (fresh) — strip loin, short loin (tenderloin) and sirloin; summed with its frozen twin (0202305045). Not split finer at HS10; data from 2017.

records.name: Artichoke
records.import_note: Fresh globe artichokes; data 2012+.

records.name: Bell pepper
records.import_note: All sweet bell-type peppers — every color, field & greenhouse, organic or not — summed via the HS8 subheading. HS10 splits peppers into bell vs chili.

records.name: Cantaloupe
records.import_note: HS6 combines other melons (cantaloupe/honeydew) and papayas; broader than cantaloupe alone.

records.name: Cherry tomato
records.import_note: Cherry tomatoes specifically, summed across entry periods and greenhouse/field lines (a subset of the all-tomatoes total on tomato).

records.name: Corn on the cob

records.name: Okra

records.name: Red leaf lettuce

records.name: Snow peas

records.name: Spinach
records.import_note: Spinach, New Zealand spinach and orache, combined.

records.name: Green leaf lettuce
records.import_note: HS10 combines red and green leaf lettuce; summed across entry periods (0705192060).

records.name: Raspberry

records.name: Carrot

records.name: Clams

records.name: Collard greens

records.name: Scallops

records.name: Shrimp (head-on)
records.import_note: Frozen shell-on shrimp, summed across all count-per-kg size grades (farmed + wild). HS does not distinguish head-on from headless shell-on, so both shell slugs share this stream.

records.name: Shrimp (P&D)
records.import_note: Peeled (P&D) shrimp — farmed + wild (0306170042) summed. The dominant import form.

records.name: Shrimp (shell-on)
records.import_note: Frozen shell-on shrimp, summed across all count-per-kg size grades (farmed + wild). HS does not distinguish head-on from headless shell-on, so both shell slugs share this stream.

records.name: Squid
records.import_note: Squid only (fillets + Loligo + other squid), summed; excludes the cuttlefish that shares the HS6 code.

records.name: Tomato
records.import_note: All fresh tomatoes (2010-2025 full history). Cherry tomatoes are also broken out to cherry-tomato at HS10 — a subset of this total, not additional; roma and grape are distinct HS10 types left for a specialty pass.

records.name: Tuna loin
records.import_note: Frozen tuna (Thunnus + skipjack), the dominant import form; fresh tuna is separate codes.

records.name: Whole crab

records.name: Whole halibut

records.name: Whole lobster
records.import_note: Frozen lobster; fresh/live lobster is a separate code.

records.name: Whole salmon
records.import_note: Fresh whole Atlantic/Danube salmon (excludes fillets); data 2012+ (pre-2012 sat under a prior code).

records.name: Whole trout
records.import_note: Fresh whole trout (Salmo trutta and relatives).

records.name: Zucchini

records.name: Jicama

records.name: Snapper

records.name: Mahi-mahi
